description: Land Acquisition - Welikada, Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple parcels of land (22 lots totaling 1.2115 hectares) in Welikada for the Elevated Highway Project.
